methodology: Network profile comparison: same prod dist (http://127.0.0.1:7792) measured with Pixel 5 + 4× CPU throttle under 4 different network profiles. Each profile = 3-5 runs. FCP/LCP via PerformanceObserver (addInitScript). TBT = total blocking time (sum of (longtask.duration - 50ms) for all long tasks > 50ms after FCP).
summary: The bundle passes FCP/LCP/TBT thresholds under Fast 4G (9 Mbps) and No-Throttle. Under Lighthouse Slow-4G default (1.6 Mbps + 150ms RTT + 4× CPU), FCP/LCP exceed thresholds because the network and CPU throttling together push the bundle beyond the 1.8s mark. The Slow-4G profile is intentionally conservative — it represents very poor cellular conditions. Under regular 4G (4 Mbps) which is the median real-world mobile speed, FCP is 1.9s, just over threshold.
